evidence.says: Script Extender declares esv::character_creation::UpdatesComponent::Updates at +0x0 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/CharacterCreation.h:393): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types. Not checked against the game's code.
the game's executable keeps this type name among its ECS type names (gatekit symbols types)
in a change-appearance session (Osi.StartChangeAppearance on the host of a running level) one server entity carries it alone, with an empty Updates map, while nothing is being edited

survey.from: Script Extender's declarations (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/CharacterCreation.h:393, kind component), by gatekit symbols se-layouts on 2026-11-14
survey.names: Every name here is Script Extender's author's (his headers), not the game's own: they are kept because they are what the extender's Lua answers to and what bg3_verify compares, and every field carries the rung `extender` - the extender's name for the field at that offset, which nobody has checked against the game's code. A name is raised from `extender` only with evidence from the code, by `gatekit names set`.
